plots.caption: Two synthetic seven-point energy paths in eV, relative to each path's first point. Lines connect stored images without fitting. Endpoint tilt retained; no converged NEB or barrier prediction. Seven original nodes shown as points; shape-preserving PCHIP (factor 16) is display-only, not extra images, fits or stationary points. Barriers use source nodes.
Synthetic DOS-shaped function, 121 samples, energy relative to an arbitrary reference in eV and toy states/eV. No electronic structure calculation, occupation or integrated state-count validation.
Synthetic g(r)-shaped function, 121 samples, r in angstrom and dimensionless g(r). No trajectory, atom selection, coordination-number or normalization validation.
Synthetic MSD-shaped curve, 121 samples from 0 to 10 ps, angstrom squared. No trajectory, PBC unwrapping, statistical blocks or diffusion fit.
